subject: Discovery recap + request to schedule technical deep dive & eval kickoff
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@healthsync.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Jun 2025 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap + request to schedule technical deep dive & eval kickoff

Hi Samir / Leah —

Thanks again for the time today — quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

Summary from discovery call:
- Primary goal: embed clinical note summarization and triage suggestions into the intake workflow (~50k notes/month, 90th percentile latency target <1s token generation for short responses)
- Data: PHI-sensitive, preference for VPC/private deployment or dedicated capacity with customer-managed KMS
- Success criteria for evaluation: accuracy on 3 prompt templates (summaries, triage flags, recommended follow-ups), latency below 200ms median for single-turn, and end-to-end integration with your ingest pipeline (S3 -> Redwood API)
- Security asks: SOC2 evidence, retention and audit log policy, and encryption-at-rest details

Proposed next actions:
1) Schedule a 60-minute technical deep dive / eval kickoff (scope: pipeline integration, prompt set review, trial plan & success criteria).
2) Share an initial trial charter and prompt pack for you to review before the kickoff.
3) Rishi and Priyom will be onsite for the technical deep dive to cover integration and laterops (batching/cache recommendations).

Suggested slots (all PT): Wed 6/18 10:00–11:00, Thu 6/19 14:00–15:00, or Fri 6/20 09:30–10:30. Alternatively, here’s a quick Calendly link: https://calendly.com/redwood-inference/tech-deepdive-60

I attached a short trial-charter-v1.pdf that outlines the baseline trial plan + the initial prompt set we recommend. If you prefer, we can make the kickoff a two-part session (30m scoping, 30m hands-on prompt workshop) — shout which you’d prefer and which slot works.

Prework request (small): please share a representative sample of 50 notes (sanitized) and confirm whether you want private deployment or dedicated.

Thanks — looking forward to locking a time.

Best,
Ava Chen
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments: trial-charter-v1.pdf
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@healthsync.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Leah Moreno <leah.moreno@healthsync.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Jun 2025 18:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + request to schedule technical deep dive & eval kickoff

Hi Ava —

Appreciate the clear recap. Wed 6/18 10:00 PT should work for our team. Leah and I prefer the two-part format — 30m scoping, 30m workshop sounds ideal.

A few notes from our side: 
- We can produce a sanitized sample of 50 notes by EOD Mon 6/23 (will remove PHI fields).
- Security: I attached a quick list of our security questions so your compliance folks can take a look ahead of time.
- For the trial, initial preference is Dedicated (predictable throughput) but we may evaluate private deployment depending on KMS requirements.

Can you confirm which internal attendees from Redwood will be on the kickoff and whether we need to set up a temporary S3 bucket for sample uploads?

Thanks — Samir

Attachments: security-questions.pdf

Confirmed Redwood attendees:
- Ava Chen (Solutions Eng) — host / scoping + prompt workshop lead
- Rishi Malhotra (SRE / Runtime) — integration, latency/throughput expectations

- Upload sanitized sample notes to this temporary S3 link (we’ll send a pre-signed upload URL in a separate email).

If anything changes on your side, let me know and we’ll pivot. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Ava
